query:
SELECT
                u.id,
                u.email,
                u.first_name,
                u.last_name,
                u.password_hash,
                u.is_active,
                u.is_verified,
                COALESCE(
                    (SELECT MIN(hs.created_at) FROM host_staff hs WHERE hs.staff_user_id = u.id),
                    u.created_at
                ) AS "invited_at!"
            FROM "user" u
            WHERE u.id = $1
              AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
              AND (
                  'staff'::user_role = ANY(u.roles)
                  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM host_staff hs WHERE hs.staff_user_id = u.id)
              )
